items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Patty' is mentioned by the Interviewer in a quote ('Patty, I don't want that ever to be broadcast'), but the Interviewee (Charlie Barnet) does not mention Patty, nor does he describe any personal relationship with them.

ctx.x: What'd he do, erase it accidentally?
No. He said to me, he says, 'Patty,

I don't want that ever to be broadcast. What just went on in here," he said, "must never be broadcast." He said, "Get that tape." I said, "I can't get that tape from that man. That man has something that nobody has, what just went on in there." He says, "Your assignment is to get that tape. I don't want it broadcast." And so I went out looking for Bill Struther in the Grove, and he'd gone. He took his tape and went home. And so I figured that I'd wait until the next morning and try to figure out something, went…
